question: What assets across all markets — stocks, crypto, forex — are showing RSI above 70 right now?
result_summary: screen_unified returned 60 results (capped=true, actual universe >100) with `overbought` pattern across all three asset types. However, due to sort=rsi, ALL 60 returned rows are Crypto (.CC) with RSI=100. Stocks ARE overbought (20 hits, top AMR.US RSI=84.4) and Forex ARE overbought (20 hits, top XOFGBP.FOREX RSI=100) when screened separately, but in the combined multi-asset screen the crypto RSI=100 flood dominates the 60-row buffer and squeezes out stocks and forex entirely from the returned set.
reason: Screen correctly covers all three asset types and RSI values are confirmed above 70, but the sorted combined response shows ONLY crypto in the returned 60 rows — stocks and forex are displaced by the crypto RSI=100 flood. Acceptance criterion 'returns results from more than one asset type' fails on the actual result set.

defects.desc: When sort=rsi is used on a combined multi-asset screen, crypto assets (RSI=100 stagnant tokens) dominate the entire result buffer, making it impossible for the client to see stocks/forex hits in a single call. The tool should either (a) cap per-asset-type representation, (b) warn that the buffer is single-asset-type dominated, or (c) not sort by oscillator when spanning asset types with very different RSI distributions.
